newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA JUNE TRACTOR SALES FALL 9.5 PERCENT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA JUNE TRACTOR SALES FALL 9.5 PERCENT YR/YR.

text.p: South African tractor sales were 9.5 percent down on a year ago in June at 427 units and in the year to date sales were down 3.8 percent to 2,718, the Agricultural Machinery Association said on Friday.
The association said the factors behind disappointing sales were similar to last month's reasons of late rains which delayed summer crop harvesting and uncertainty about future price prospects.
Industry sources said initial predictions of 6,000 units for 1997 were now being revised down to possible sales of 5,500 units.
